# Cheapflights

> Cheapflights is a global flight comparison and travel booking platform that helps users find cheap flights, airline tickets, and travel deals across thousands of destinations.

Cheapflights aggregates real-time flight pricing from major airlines and booking partners including Expedia, Kiwi.com, and Priceline. The platform specializes in budget travel search, price comparison, and booking tools for flights, car rentals, and travel packages to popular destinations worldwide.

## Core Flight Search & Booking

- [Cheapflights Homepage](https://www.cheapflights.com): Main flight comparison, deals, and booking platform
- [Flight Search & Comparison](https://www.cheapflights.com/flights): Main flight search and comparison page for global destinations
- [Book Flights Online](https://www.cheapflights.com/book-flights-online): Flight booking tool for Las Vegas, Hawaii, Florida destinations
- [Book Car Hire](https://www.cheapflights.com/book-car-hire): Car rental comparison and booking service across destinations
